characters.name: Yahweh
aliases: God of the armies of Israel
characters.note: The God invoked by David; not depicted as a human figure.

characters.name: Saul
characters.note: King of Israel and commander of the Israelite forces.

characters.name: David
characters.note: Young shepherd who fights and kills Goliath.

characters.name: Goliath
characters.note: Philistine warrior from Gath; described as exceptionally tall and heavily armed.

characters.name: Jesse
characters.note: Elderly father of David and his brothers.

characters.name: Eliab
characters.note: Oldest of Jesse's three sons present at the battle.

characters.name: Abinadab
characters.note: Second-oldest of Jesse's three sons at the battle.

characters.name: Shammah
characters.note: Third of Jesse's sons at the battle.

characters.name: Abner
characters.note: Commander who brings David before Saul after the victory.

characters.name: Goliath's shield bearer
aliases: the man who bore the shield

characters.name: Sheep keeper
characters.note: Unnamed person left to tend Jesse's sheep while David goes to the army.

characters.name: Lion
characters.note: Wild animal attacked and killed by David while protecting sheep.

characters.name: Bear
characters.note: Wild animal attacked and killed by David while protecting sheep.

characters.name: Birds of the sky
characters.note: Birds invoked as scavengers; not individualized.

characters.name: Animals of the field
characters.note: Wild animals invoked as scavengers; collective.

locations.name: Ephesdammim
locations.note: Area between Socoh and Azekah where the Philistines encamped.

locations.name: Valley of Elah
locations.note: Battle valley between the Israelite and Philistine positions.

locations.name: Bethlehem
locations.note: David's home and the place where Jesse's sheep are kept.

locations.name: Wilderness
locations.note: Open land where David's sheep are mentioned as grazing.

locations.name: Israelite camp
locations.note: Israelite military camp in the valley.

locations.name: Brook
locations.note: Stream from which David selects five smooth stones.

locations.name: Gai
locations.note: Point reached during Israel's pursuit of the fleeing Philistines.

locations.name: Ekron
locations.note: Philistine city toward which the Philistines flee.

locations.name: Shaaraim
locations.note: Route where wounded Philistines fall during the pursuit.

locations.name: Gath
locations.note: Goliath's city and a place reached by the fleeing or fallen Philistines.

locations.name: Jerusalem
locations.note: City to which David brings Goliath's head.

locations.name: David's tent
locations.note: Place where David stores Goliath's armor.

sections.title: Jesse sends David to his brothers
Israel pursues and plunders the Philistines

brief.era: Iron Age, during the early Israelite monarchy.
brief.place: The Valley of Elah and opposing Israelite and Philistine camps, with Bethlehem and Jerusalem as supporting locations.
brief.dress: Ancient Levantine military and pastoral clothing. Saul and Goliath wear bronze armor; Goliath carries a spear and javelin, with a shield bearer. David begins as a shepherd and fights with a sling.
brief.buildings_and_objects: Military camps, wagons, tents, banners or weapons, bronze helmet and mail, shield, spear, javelin, sword, shepherd's bag, sling, smooth stones, provisions, sheep, and Goliath's severed head and armor.
depiction_rules: Depict Yahweh as unseen or through implied divine presence, not as a human figure.
Show Goliath as unusually tall and heavily armored, contrasting with youthful David.
Keep David's victory centered on the sling and stone before the sword is taken from Goliath.
